purpose: How every Blender build runs when the build is also a teaching video: one Blender window kept open, every pass a recorded round (ask, first result, tweak, second result) in rounds/plan.md, the owner's feedback as new rounds, OCR privacy scan, GPU only under a grant, recording until the owner approves.

model.notes: big builds and visual judgement; run by a dedicated builder agent. The main seat relays reports to the owner.

owner_approval: GPU use only under a current gpu-time grant or the owner's own override
no downloads, installs, sign-ins or servers without the owner's OK (installed tools may be used for a job he gave)
evaluation: A round recorded with the recorder prints SESSION OK and writes session.json with ask/first_result/tweak/second_result; the OCR check reports 0 banned hits on every recording folder; engine exports print CHECK PASS from the export check; the window was never closed between rounds.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python plus Blender 5.0; the recorder is plain Python and Blender's own API; OCR uses Windows' built-in engine.
